style.art: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image.
style.object: A single object only, centered, filling most of the frame, on a plain pure white background, no ground shadow, nothing else in the picture. Draw exactly what is described and nothing more: animals look natural with no clothes, hats, bags, tools or accessories unless the description says so; no extra props.
style.scene: Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet.
style.character_sheet: Full body, standing, facing the viewer, friendly expression, centered on a plain pure white background, no shadow, no props beyond what is described.

pip.name: Pip
pip.desc: a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf
pip.personality: a baby songbird that can read short words and pair sounds now; with magic e it reads the short word and the e in broken pieces at first (cap-e!), and in Unit 5 it says its first magic word, cape!; with vowel teams it says the two vowels apart once, then reads the word; in Unit 10 the last song piece comes back to it, and at the Song Tree it sings the whole song
pip.role_ko: 단어를 읽는 아기 새. 마법 e 단어를 "캡-이!" 하고 끊어 읽다가 5유닛에서 첫 마법 단어 "케이프!"를 말해요. 10유닛에서 마지막 노래 조각을 찾고, 노래 나무 앞에서 노래 전체를 불러요.

bun.name: Bun
bun.desc: a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile
bun.personality: brave and curious, always the first to shout the sound
bun.role_ko: 씩씩한 토끼. 제일 먼저 나서요. "해 보자!"

hedgie.name: Hedgie
hedgie.desc: a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes
hedgie.personality: careful and thoughtful, great at finding hidden things
hedgie.role_ko: 조심스러운 고슴도치. 숨은 물건을 잘 찾아요. "우와!"

grumble.name: Grumble
grumble.desc: a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers
grumble.personality: the grumpy old raccoon, now living in a quiet tower room of the Magic Castle and saying Shh! from the castle windows; he warns the friends about bees, lowers a rope, brings tea and toast, and keeps practicing quietly on his little drum; in the top room he beats it out loud for the first time, and at the Song Tree he drums while everyone sings
grumble.role_ko: 성 창문에서 "쉿!" 하는 너구리 할아버지. 벌을 조심하라고 알려 주고 밧줄을 내려 주며 점점 친구가 돼요. 몰래 북을 연습하다가 마지막엔 북을 치며 함께 노래해요.

beads.name: Beads
beads.desc: a small friendly caterpillar whose body is a string of five round beads in rainbow colors (red, orange, yellow, green, blue), big round sparkling eyes, two tiny antennae tipped with little beads, a cheerful open smile, no letters on the beads
beads.personality: a bead caterpillar who threads letter beads together to make words; counts beads, clicks them together, says the whole word proudly after the sounds
beads.role_ko: 구슬 애벌레. 글자 구슬을 꿰어 단어를 만들어요. "딸깍딸깍!"

fairy.name: Fairy E
fairy.desc: a tiny palm-sized fairy glowing with soft golden light, a round rosy face with big sparkling eyes, short wavy lilac hair, a little dress made of pale-green leaf petals, two round see-through wings like soap bubbles, holding a thin wand tipped with a small yellow star, no letters or symbols drawn anywhere on her or her wand
fairy.personality: a shy, giggly castle fairy who taps the end of a word-picture with her star wand to add a sparkling silent e, turning short-vowel things into new long-vowel things (cap into cape); for vowel teams she melts two sparkles into one; she mostly says Eee! and only very short words
fairy.role_ko: 성에 사는 손바닥만 한 요정. 별 지팡이로 단어 끝에 반짝 e 를 붙여 단어를 바꿔요(cap → cape). 모음 짝 유닛에서는 반짝이 둘을 하나로 합쳐요. "이~!" 하고 짧게만 말해요.

pose_desc.ref: standing straight, arms relaxed at the sides, friendly smile, looking at the viewer
pose_desc.happy: jumping with both arms raised high, big open-mouth smile
pose_desc.surprised: eyes wide, mouth open in an O, hands up near the face
pose_desc.pointing: pointing to the right with one arm fully extended, looking that way, excited
pose_desc.thinking: one finger on the chin, looking up, puzzled
pose_desc.cheering: both fists raised in victory, laughing
pose_desc.glow: glowing brightly with little sparkles around, eyes closed in delight
pose_desc.sad: drooping leaf, big sad eyes, a single tear
pose_desc.hiding: peeking out from behind something, only half visible, nervous
pose_desc.sleeping: eyes closed, tiny snore bubble, relaxed
pose_desc.shh: one paw pressed to the mouth in a shh gesture, frowning, only the upper body out of a dirt hole
pose_desc.popping: bursting up out of a dirt hole with dirt flying, startled
pose_desc.angry: frowning with crossed arms, cheeks puffed
pose_desc.drum: happily beating a small drum with two sticks, grinning

cover.desc: Picture-book cover illustration. A tall friendly pastel castle with round towers and pointed blue roofs stands on a green hill under a bright sky. In front of its big round wooden gate, Pip, the tiny yellow baby bird with a green leaf scarf, sings with its beak open and a golden note above it; Fairy E, a tiny glowing fairy with bubble wings and a star-tipped wand, swirls sparkles around Pip; Bun the white rabbit, wearing a red cape, and Hedgie the hedgehog cheer beside them; Beads the rainbow bead caterpillar rides on Hedgie's flower; high up in a tower window Grumble the old raccoon leans out with his lantern and a small drum, a tiny smile under his frown. No letters anywhere. Leave a calm, simple sky area at the top for the title.
cover.ko: 표지. 마법 성 대문 앞에서 노래하는 핍, 반짝이를 뿌리는 요정 이, 빨간 망토를 두른 번과 헤지, 비즈, 탑 창문의 그럼블.

front.desc: Title page vignette: a small round picture of Pip and Fairy E — the tiny glowing fairy sits on Pip's head and taps the air with her star wand, one little sparkle twinkling — on a plain cream background with a few tiny stars. Lots of empty space around the vignette. No letters anywhere.
front.ko: 속표지. 핍의 머리 위에 앉아 별 지팡이를 흔드는 요정 이.

front.desc: A hand-drawn storybook map of the Magic Castle drawn like a cutaway seen from the side: at the bottom the forest path and the big round gate, then a courtyard with a small lake and a cave; a hedge garden with tall pine trees; a great stone hall with stairs; a blue-tiled bathroom and a sand-dune room; a round riddle room; a toy room with a train track; a tower room with a tree and a window over the sea; a broken bridge over a moat; a rooftop garden with a little couch; and the tallest tower's dark top room with a round window. Small dotted paths link the rooms. No letters or text anywhere.
front.ko: 마법 성 지도예요. 대문, 안뜰, 정원, 큰 홀, 욕실, 수수께끼 방, 장난감 방, 탑 방, 다리, 옥상, 꼭대기 방이 있어요.

back.desc: Final page: a starry night on the green hill of the Song Tree, seen from behind. Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Beads, Fairy E and Grumble sit in a row on a big root looking up at the giant tree, which glows softly and sings, golden notes drifting up into the sky like fireflies; Grumble's drum rests beside him and his lantern hangs from a branch; around the hill many animal friends sleep, among them the twin bluebirds Pim and Pam (two tiny sky-blue birds always side by side, one with a small red feather tuft and one with a small yellow feather tuft). Far away on the horizon, tiny in the moonlight, are the castle, the forest, the pond and the garden. Calm and warm. No letters anywhere.
back.ko: 노래 나무 아래 나란히 앉은 여섯 친구의 뒷모습. 나무가 노래하고 금빛 음표가 반딧불처럼 올라가요. 이야기 끝.

back.desc: The same hand-drawn cutaway map of the Magic Castle as before, but now every room is lit warmly, a trail of tiny bird footprints runs from the gate all the way up to the top room, and from the top room's round window a golden path of light leads far away to a small glowing Song Tree drawn at the edge of the map. No letters or text anywhere.
back.ko: 모든 방에 불이 켜진 마법 성 지도. 발자국이 꼭대기 방까지 이어지고, 금빛 길이 노래 나무로 뻗어 있어요.

style_v1.art: Children's picture-book illustration, hand-drawn 2D style, thick soft dark-brown outlines, flat bright cheerful colors with a light paper texture and gentle watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes. No photo-realism, no 3D render look. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image.
style_v1.object: A single object only, centered, filling most of the frame, on a plain pure white background, no shadow on the ground, nothing else in the picture.
style_v1.scene: Full illustrated scene with a simple uncluttered background and a calm, simple sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind.
style_v1.character_sheet: Full body, standing, facing the viewer, friendly expression, centered on a plain pure white background, no shadow, no props beyond what is described.

story_arc.ko: 짝꿍 숲 끝의 마법 성은 단어가 바뀌는 수수께끼로 잠겨 있어요. 손바닥만 한 요정 이가 별 지팡이로 단어 끝에 반짝 e 를 붙이면 cap 이 cape 로 바뀌어요. 핍은 "캡-이!" 하고 끊어 읽다가 5유닛에서 첫 마법 단어 "케이프!"를 말해요. 6유닛부터는 두 모음이 한 소리를 내는 짝으로 비를 그치고, 나무를 깨우고, 배를 띄우고, 달을 꺼내요. 10유닛 꼭대기 방에서 노래 조각 넷을 찾고, 11유닛에서 노래 나무가 다시 노래해요. 모두 함께 주제가를 불러요.
story_arc.books_ko: 옛날에 노래 나무가 부르던 소리 노래가 네 조각으로 흩어졌어요. 1권 소리 정원, 2권 단어 연못, 3권 짝꿍 숲, 4권 마법 성에서 조각을 하나씩 찾아요. 4권에서 마지막 조각을 찾아 노래 나무가 다시 노래하고, 시리즈가 끝나요.
story_arc.characters_ko: 핍은 이제 긴 모음 단어를 읽고 마지막엔 노래 전체를 불러요. 번과 헤지, 비즈가 함께하고, 새 친구 요정 이가 별 지팡이로 마법 e 를 붙이고 반짝이 둘을 하나로 합쳐 줘요. 그럼블은 성 창문에서 "쉿!" 하다가 벌을 조심하라고 알려 주고, 밧줄을 내려 주고, 차와 토스트를 챙겨 주며, 마지막엔 북을 치며 함께 노래해요.
